jsBoy.subtitle: Enterprise Delivery Management
jsBoy.description: Platform for managing a family delivery business, with client management, delivery agents, orders, pricing and operational tracking.
jsBoy.problem: Manual processes and decentralized information made it hard to track deliveries.
jsBoy.contribution: Building the web application, API and database, with role-based authentication and ongoing evolution of the operational flow.

sonhoDePudim.subtitle: Digital storefront & orders
sonhoDePudim.description: Institutional website and digital storefront for the artisan bakery Sonho de Pudim, showcasing flavors and sizes, social proof, and integrated iFood and WhatsApp ordering.
sonhoDePudim.problem: Bringing sizes, traditional and lactose-free options, and multiple ordering channels (iFood, events, wholesale, and direct support) together in a fast mobile experience.
sonhoDePudim.contribution: End-to-end development in Angular with Signals and SCSS, unified modal for orders and event quotes via WhatsApp, scroll animations, and Vercel deployment.

mdFilms.subtitle: Audiovisual portfolio & quotes
mdFilms.description: Portfolio and package catalog for audiovisual professional Madu Reis, combining filterable work, event coverage packages, and a custom quote builder sent to WhatsApp.
mdFilms.problem: Presenting wedding and event photo/film packages while letting clients customize hours, crew, and deliverables without friction.
mdFilms.contribution: Built in Angular 22 with routing, filterable gallery, multi-step custom package modal, automated WhatsApp quote builder, rule tests, and Vercel deployment.
